sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000097-P1, was presented by MERCK & COMPANY (the Supplier) to Atlantic Health Network 097 on September 10, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 3.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a HPV share floor of 85%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
